note: Russian-style transcription; Ukrainian writes jing as цзін (Тяньцзінь).
Russian-style transcription of jí; Ukrainian writes цзі, like the ці in Уці.
Rùqīn has q, which is ц; цзінь would be jīn.
Japanese h is х in Ukrainian transcription (Хіросіма), so Mahoroba is Махороба.
Pinyin ng before a consonant gives н, as in Чанчунь, so Penglai is Пенлай.
Goose is pronounced гус; Гас reads as Gus.
Hohkee (hockey) has no н; the transliteration is Хокі.
Spanish ci is сі and j is х, so Encrucijada is Енкрусіхада.
Spanish c before á is к, so Cántico is Кантіко.
Spanish cio is сіо, not the Italian-style ць, so Palacio is Паласіо.
УЗЕЛ is Russian; the Ukrainian for node is вузол.
МОСТ is the Russian form; the Ukrainian for bridge is міст.
Current orthography does not double р in this loanword (тераформування, терабайт).
СНАБЖЕННЯ is a Russian word; the Ukrainian is постачання.
